description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the DropMillisecondsHibernateInterceptor in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing that date objects have their milliseconds zeroed out when saving or updating, and ensuring that certain date/time objects are not modified.

classes.name: DropMillisecondsHibernateInterceptorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for DropMillisecondsHibernateInterceptor, verifying date/millisecond handling during entity save/update operations.

methods.name: shouldClearMillisecondsWhenSavingANewObject
methods.description: Tests that the interceptor zeroes out milliseconds on a new Person entity before saving.

methods.name: shouldClearMillisecondsWhenUpdatingAnExistingObject
methods.description: Tests that the interceptor zeroes out milliseconds on an existing Person entity before updating.

methods.name: shouldNotChangeWhenInstanceOfTime
methods.description: Ensures that the interceptor does not modify Time objects.

methods.name: shouldNotThrowUnsupportedOperationExceptionWhenInstanceOfSqlDate
methods.description: Ensures that the interceptor does not modify java.sql.Date objects.
